data.long_meaning: Derived from the Celtic word ‘Ion’, meaning ‘island’. The name Iona is often associated with the Island of Iona in Scotland, which was an important religious site in early Christianity. The name symbolizes a place of refuge, spiritual growth, and connection to nature. The name Iona carries the meaning “Island of the Yew” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Iona usually hope their child will grow to embody island of the yew and live with faith, good character and purpose.
